inval: Comparables that are not really comparable (view, floor, standing, real distance to the slopes; '2 bedrooms' wrongly declared, see the Airbnb title '3 bedrooms')
Dynamic prices read today for distant dates: platforms may show a low or high placeholder price unrelated to the final price; a survey is not a concluded booking
World Championships: part of the beds may be block-booked by the organisation, teams or agencies, outside public listings; public demand and prices are biased, freeze date unknown
2027 demand unknown: no Richemont 3B history (launched 2026, 2 reviews); occupancy is a pure assumption
ImmoCrans mandate: if it sets prices or imposes date exclusivity, the recommendation is only a proposal
ImmoCrans commission unknown; possible contractual price parity; tourist tax (amount and collector) not re-read
Seasonality of supply: the number of active listings differs by period, so n is small off-season
Fees included or not in the totals read (Airbnb host-only: total close to the traveller price)
